shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover glow on interactive cards.

components.name: Button Card
components.description: Signature component. A tappable card representing a Home Assistant entity. Shows icon, label, and state with glow feedback.
components.html:
💡
Chambre
● ON
components.css: .ds-btn-card {  background: #151f3d;  border: 1px solid #11192d;  border-radius: 1rem;  padding: 1.5rem 1rem;  text-align: center;  cursor: pointer;  transition: all 0.3s ease;  user-select: none;}.ds-btn-card:hover {  transform: translateY(-2px);  border-color: #4a9eff;  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.15);}.ds-btn-card:active {  transform: scale(0.97);}.ds-btn-card.is-on {  border-color: #22c55e;  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);}.ds-btn-card__icon {  font-size: 2.5rem;  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;}.ds-btn-card__label {  font-weight: 500;  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;  font-size: 0.9rem;  color: #e0e6f0;}.ds-btn-card__state {  font-size: 0.8rem;}.ds-btn-card__state--on {  color: #22c55e;  font-weight: 600;}.ds-btn-card__state--off {  color: #8892a8;}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button with gradient background.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary {  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4a9eff, #8b5cf6);  color: #e0e6f0;  border: none;  padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;  border-radius: 0.5rem;  font-weight: 500;  font-size: 1rem;  cursor: pointer;  transition: opacity 0.2s;}.ds-btn-primary:hover {  opacity: 0.9;}.ds-btn-primary:disabled {  opacity: 0.5;  cursor: not-allowed;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lesser action button with filled background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary {  background: #151f3d;  color: #e0e6f0;  border: 1px solid #11192d;  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;  border-radius: 0.5rem;  cursor: pointer;  transition: border-color 0.2s;}.ds-btn-secondary:hover {  border-color: #4a9eff;}

components.name: Card
components.description: General container with rounded corners and subtle border.
components.css: .ds-card {  background: #151f3d;  border: 1px solid #11192d;  border-radius: 1rem;  padding: 1rem;  transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;}.ds-card:hover {  border-color: #4a9eff;}

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input {  width: 100%;  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;  background: #0b1020;  border: 1px solid #11192d;  border-radius: 0.5rem;  color: #e0e6f0;  font-size: 0.95rem;}.ds-input:focus {  outline: none;  border-color: #4a9eff;}

components.name: Menu Panel
components.description: Hamburger menu overlay with navigation items.
components.css: .ds-menu {  background: #11192d;  border: 1px solid #11192d;  border-radius: 1rem;  padding: 1rem;  width: 90%;  max-width: 350px;  display: flex;  flex-direction: column;  gap: 0.25rem;}.ds-menu a {  display: block;  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;  color: #e0e6f0;  text-decoration: none;  border-radius: 0.5rem;  transition: background 0.2s;}.ds-menu a:hover {  background: #151f3d;}

narrative.overview: Imaginez un salon privé, tard le soir. Le velours sombre des murs absorbe le bruit du monde extérieur. Une seule lumière chaude émerge d'un lampadaire — elle guide, elle n'éclaire pas tout. Ici, chaque interaction est deliberate, tactile, satisfaisante.
keyCharacteristics: Palette sombre et riche (bleu nuit profond)
Glow lumineux comme indicateur de profondeur (pas d'ombres)
Feedback tactile fort au tap (scale + transition)

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: L'Electric Blue apparaît sur ≤10% de la surface visible. Sa rareté est sa force.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Les surfaces sont plates au repos. La lumière n'apparaît qu'en réponse à l'interaction.

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: Pas de Google Fonts, pas de chargement externe. La police du système est rapide, familière.

dos: Do utiliser le glow comme indicateur d'interactivité
Do maintenir l'accent Electric Blue rare (≤10%)
Do privilégier les coins arrondis pour la douceur
Do utiliser le gradient uniquement sur les actions principales
Do ajouter un feedback tactile fort au tap
donts: Don't ajouter de bordures latérales colorées >1px
Don't empiler les cartes les unes sur les autres
Don't utiliser de texte en majuscules avec tracking large
Don't créer de grilles identiques sans variation
Don't utiliser de nombres séquentiels comme scaffolding
Don't laisser le texte déborder du container
